descriptionChirho: Qal basic sense of verbal communication: to say something to someone, introduce direct or indirect speech, command, or answer — the default and overwhelmingly dominant sense of אמר.
Qal use of אמר for internal speech or deliberation, often rendered 'I said (in my heart)' or 'I thought,' expressing an inner resolve or reflection rather than audible speech.
Hifil and emphatic Qal usage meaning to declare publicly, proclaim, or formally announce — a more solemn or authoritative speech act than ordinary saying.
